title: Active Border Only When Selected
description: Panels, panes, windows, introduction steps, etc can all be activated. Only show the active border (primary color) when something is actively selected. If the ui element is activated then remove the introduction state; afterwards it is shown normal.
summary: Window dock silhouettes no longer paint the primary active stroke from layout activeWindowId alone — they follow useSurfaceActive (click/focus), matching panels and panes. Activating a surface clears its data-introduced stamps so the active stroke wins. Introduction step chrome starts introduced, becomes active on click, then normal after a background click without re-entering the introduced pulse for that step. Fixed useSurfaceActive layout cleanup so same-commit re-registers do not drop the active root. Extended vitests for Mode silhouettes, introduction activate/normal, and introduced-stamp clearing.
